items.title: Google Skillshop digital skills
items.summary: Google offers free Google Ads training on Skillshop. The linked Fundamentals of Digital Marketing course covers beginner digital marketing; check its current terms.
items.bestFor: Beginners, jobseekers and small business owners
requirements: Sign in to track completion. Fundamentals is listed as a self-paced, 40-hour beginner course.
items.watchOut: Fundamentals now issues a digital award rather than the old Digital Garage certificate. Confirm the selected course cost; not every Google training programme is free.

items.title: Microsoft Learn South Africa
items.summary: Free Microsoft Learn training content, with module badges and learning-path trophies distinct from assessed credentials.
items.bestFor: Students, IT beginners and people building technical skills
requirements: A Learn profile saves progress. Check each module for prerequisites, software and subscription needs.
items.watchOut: Former Learn sandboxes are no longer available. Azure exercises can require a subscription and incur usage costs; certification exams can cost extra.

items.title: Vodacom Digital Skills Hub
items.summary: Free digital-skills courses, with some learning routes promoted as zero-rated for Vodacom users.
items.bestFor: Young people and jobseekers looking for digital skills
requirements: Registration is usually required; data benefits may depend on network and current programme rules.
items.watchOut: Confirm the current course catalogue and any zero-rated data wording on Vodacom's own page.

items.title: Book Dash
items.summary: Free African children’s digital picture books to read, download, print and share under the CC BY 4.0 licence.
items.bestFor: Parents, teachers, libraries and reading clubs
requirements: Use the official catalogue and retain the required attribution. Internet, device and printing costs remain.
items.watchOut: Free digital files do not include a free physical book delivery. Follow the licence when adapting or redistributing the books.

items.title: Nal'ibali
items.summary: Free stories, audio stories, printables and reading resources in South African languages.
items.bestFor: Families, teachers and caregivers of children aged 0-12
requirements: No purchase needed for online resources; downloads and printing may use data or paper.
items.watchOut: Choose the language and age level that fits the child instead of downloading random PDFs.

items.title: FunDza
items.summary: Mobile-friendly South African stories, reading content and literacy resources.
items.bestFor: Teens, young adults and mobile readers
requirements: Works best online or on mobile; account features may vary by current platform setup.
items.watchOut: It is stronger for teen and young-adult reading than preschool picture books.

items.title: Experian South Africa
items.summary: Free access to Experian personal credit report and credit score through Experian's consumer platform.
items.bestFor: Consumers checking their credit report and score
requirements: Valid South African ID details and identity verification are expected.
items.watchOut: Use Experian's official site and never share banking passwords or card PINs.

items.title: TransUnion South Africa
items.summary: Free annual credit report access from TransUnion South Africa.
items.bestFor: Consumers using their free annual bureau report right
requirements: Identity verification is required before report access.
items.watchOut: A free credit report is not the same as guaranteed credit approval.

items.title: ClearScore South Africa
items.summary: Free access to your Experian credit score and report, with personalised financial offers shown separately.
items.bestFor: Consumers who want ongoing score and report visibility
requirements: Sign-up and identity checks are required.
items.watchOut: Treat loan and credit offers as advertising or eligibility guidance, not approval.

items.title: National Consumer Commission complaints portal
items.summary: Official National Consumer Commission information and complaint route for eligible consumer complaints.
items.bestFor: Consumers who need an official complaint route under the Consumer Protection Act
requirements: A registered e-Services profile, complaint details and supporting proof may be required.
items.watchOut: This is not a giveaway. Use it for consumer-rights support and keep copies of complaint references and evidence.

items.title: Free basic municipal services
items.summary: Government guidance on free basic water, electricity, sanitation or other municipal support for qualifying households.
items.bestFor: Low-income households checking whether they qualify for municipal indigent support
requirements: Usually means-tested through the local municipality; extra usage can still be billed.
items.watchOut: Rules differ by municipality, so confirm eligibility, documents and limits with your own local municipality.

items.title: Mediclinic Baby Programme
items.summary: Free registration provides pregnancy and baby information, newsletters, webinars and support, even for parents not delivering at Mediclinic. A separate hospital baby bag is a benefit for members delivering at a Mediclinic facility.
items.bestFor: Expecting parents seeking pregnancy and newborn information
requirements: Register through Mediclinic Baby; the current programme pages give 12 weeks of pregnancy as the registration point. Members delivering at Mediclinic must separately arrange their hospital admission.
items.watchOut: Private maternity care is paid. The bag is not sent to every online registrant; contents and hospital services vary. Antenatal classes or optional services may carry charges. Check these with the selected hospital.

items.title: Bootlegger app registration coffee
items.summary: Bootlegger's official loyalty-app guide states that new users receive a free coffee on registration.
items.bestFor: New Bootlegger Coffee Company app users near a participating cafe
requirements: Download the Bootlegger app, create a new account and redeem the registration reward under the current in-app conditions.
items.watchOut: Check the reward's product choice, validity period and participating cafe availability in the app before travelling. The separate stamp reward requires ten purchases.

items.title: SA Youth work and learning support
items.provider: SA Youth work and learning support
items.summary: Free work and learning opportunity network with advertised zero-data access on the SA Youth platform.
items.bestFor: Young unemployed South Africans seeking work and learning opportunities
requirements: Register with the accepted South African identity, residency, refugee or valid work-permit documentation, and check each opportunity’s age and qualification requirements.
items.watchOut: Linked external websites may use data. Registering does not guarantee a job, interview or place on a programme.

items.title: Siyavula free Mathematics and Physical Sciences practice
items.provider: Siyavula free Mathematics and Physical Sciences practice
items.summary: Siyavula advertises free online Mathematics and Physical Sciences practice.
items.bestFor: South African learners and parents
requirements: Register a free learner account to use the practice tools; parents can register to track work. Internet access is required.
items.watchOut: Official July 2026 help specifies zero-rated access on MTN and Cell C; leaving Siyavula can incur data charges. Some networks need a small balance to begin access. Do not promise zero-rating on all networks.

items.title: Vodacom free school eLearning content
items.summary: The platform labels school content from grades R–12 as FREE; Vodacom states content and data on the service are free for its customers.
items.bestFor: School learners in grades R–12
requirements: Register/sign in and select the free school-grade sections. A compatible device and internet connection are needed.
items.watchOut: The platform also advertises premium learning subscriptions. This listing covers only the sections labelled FREE; external links and other networks can incur data costs. Do not sign up to premium content assuming it is free.

items.title: HP LIFE free business and digital courses
items.provider: HP LIFE free business and digital courses
items.summary: HP LIFE advertises free business/digital-skills courses in eight languages and free course-completion certificates.
items.bestFor: Jobseekers, learners and small-business owners
requirements: Join HP LIFE for free and select a course from the official catalogue. Device and internet/data costs remain your responsibility.
items.watchOut: A completion certificate is not a university qualification, professional licence or guaranteed job. Check each course language and content before starting.

items.title: OpenLearn free courses and participation statements
items.provider: OpenLearn free courses and participation statements
items.summary: Free Open University learning content and courses. Completing a course can earn a free Statement of Participation; selected courses also offer a free digital badge.
items.bestFor: Independent learners exploring new subjects and practical skills
requirements: Reading content does not require an account. A free account requires age 13+; enrol and complete the course pages and required quizzes to receive a statement or available badge.
items.watchOut: Statements and badges carry no formal qualification credit. OpenLearn does not grant an Open University qualification, student status or student discounts. Internet and device costs remain yours.

items.title: IBM SkillsBuild free learning for adults
items.provider: IBM SkillsBuild free learning for adults
items.summary: IBM SkillsBuild offers free online adult learning. Selected learning activities award IBM digital credentials after their requirements are completed.
items.bestFor: Adults building technology and workplace skills for a career change or job search
requirements: The adult programme is for learners aged 18+. Create a free SkillsBuild account. Accepting and managing digital credentials requires a Credly account and the relevant completion requirements.
items.watchOut: Check each activity audience: some credentials and advanced routes are restricted to learners working with a partner non-profit organisation. A digital credential does not guarantee a job. Internet and device costs remain yours.

items.title: Canva Education for eligible school educators
items.provider: Canva Education for eligible school educators
items.summary: Canva Education is free worldwide for eligible K-12 teachers and institutions, including qualifying school librarians, learning support staff and curriculum specialists.
items.bestFor: Active, eligible primary and secondary school educators and accredited schools
requirements: You must currently hold an eligible certified role at a formally accredited primary or secondary school, or apply through a qualifying institution. Verify with an accepted educational email domain or supporting documents; re-verification is required every three years.
items.watchOut: Eligibility excludes universities and their students, private tutors, parents applying only as parents, inactive teachers and unlicensed homeschool educators. This is conditional education access; normal internet and device costs apply.

items.title: LearnFree practical skills lessons
items.summary: Free, self-paced lessons and practical learning content across computing, office tools, core skills and job seeking.
items.bestFor: Beginners learning computer, office, internet and job-search skills
requirements: Use a compatible device and internet connection. Provider terms require age 18+, emancipation, or express parent or guardian permission. Registered users under 18 need parent or guardian consent; certain features require an account.
items.watchOut: This listing covers free learning content and makes no promise of an accredited qualification or free certificate. Internet and device costs remain yours; follow the provider terms for account use.

items.title: MomConnect pregnancy and baby information
items.summary: The Department of Health provides pregnancy and baby-care information through MomConnect messaging, with a helpdesk and clinic-feedback service. The official USSD registration route is free.
items.bestFor: Pregnant women and mothers using South African public-clinic maternity services
requirements: Dial *134*550*2# for free USSD registration, or send join on WhatsApp to 079 631 2456. To finish registration, obtain the public-clinic facility code from a nurse and provide your estimated delivery date through the official service.
items.watchOut: WhatsApp can use mobile data; the official page does not promise zero-rated WhatsApp. This is an information service, with no promised physical samples. Share registration and health details only with the official service.

items.title: Iziko Museums: selected free days and eligible Fridays
items.provider: Iziko Museums: selected free days and eligible Fridays
items.summary: Selected Iziko museums offer free Friday admission for South African students and pensioners with valid identification. The official 2026 commemorative-day list also includes free entry at participating open sites on 1 December (Emancipation Day) and 16 December (Reconciliation Day).
items.categoryLabel: Free family outings and public services
items.bestFor: South African students and pensioners, and visitors planning a museum day in Cape Town
requirements: Present valid identification and, for student entry, a valid student card. Check the chosen museum's hours and eligibility before travelling; the South African Museum, National Gallery and Slave Lodge are examples of participating sites. Ordinary visitors pay the normal fee outside qualifying free days.
items.watchOut: This benefit excludes the Planetarium, Castle of Good Hope and Groot Constantia for the Friday and December dates described here. Closed sites and maintenance closures are excluded. Paid shows, guided tours and separately priced activities are not included. No account or purchase is stated for ordinary qualifying admission; travel and optional spending remain payable.

items.title: Free AI Literacy Learning for SU Staff and Students
items.provider: Free AI Literacy Learning for SU Staff and Students
items.summary: Stellenbosch University offers free AI learning access to its staff and students who register with a university email address. Course access is advertised as free for eligible SU users. Device and internet access remain necessary.
items.bestFor: Stellenbosch University staff and students using an @sun.ac.za email address
requirements: SU staff/students using an @sun.ac.za address. This is not an open-to-everyone South African course. Open the university’s official course page. Choose the specific AI course offered to your staff/student group and follow its official registration link. Register with your @sun.ac.za address. The university states access is normally granted within 24–48 business hours. Complete the course requirements within the access period; the page describes approximately 90 days for the listed short-course access.
items.watchOut: Enrolment for the student-focused offering is described as open through 2026. Do not treat that as perpetual availability. Other courses and staff ULUs on the page have different hours and enrolment routes; do not mix their conditions.

items.title: Famelack: Free TV, Radio & Webcams
items.summary: Free browser access to TV, radio and webcams. No subscription or account; data costs apply.
items.bestFor: People exploring international live TV, radio and webcam views in a browser
requirements: A compatible browser and internet connection. Choose a stream on the provider website; availability varies by source and region.
items.watchOut: South African access was reported successful by a FreeHub reviewer. Individual stream availability and content rights are not guaranteed. Data costs apply.

items.title: Zorora free sofa fabric swatches
items.summary: Up to four different sofa fabric swatches with free shipping.
items.bestFor: Sofa shoppers comparing fabrics
requirements: Select swatches and check shipping for your address in Zorora’s cart.
items.watchOut: Extra swatches cost R20 each.

items.title: WeThinkCode_ free online AI course for professionals
items.provider: WeThinkCode_ free online AI course for professionals
items.summary: Free online AI training in scheduled cohorts.
items.bestFor: People using AI at work or in study
requirements: Apply with a work or student email. Internet access is required.
items.watchOut: Check the official portal for dates and available places.

items.title: Department of Basic Education free school textbooks
items.provider: Department of Basic Education free school textbooks
items.summary: Download selected state-owned school textbooks for free.
items.bestFor: South African learners, parents and teachers
requirements: Choose the right grade, subject, language and edition.
items.watchOut: Data and printing can still cost money.

items.title: SAP Learning Hub student edition
items.summary: A renewable 12-month student subscription with SAP learning journeys, practice systems, live sessions and two certification exam attempts.
items.bestFor: University students and faculty learning SAP skills
requirements: Verify active university enrolment or faculty status with SAP. An SAP Universal ID, university email and an internet-connected device are needed.
items.watchOut: Only eligible academic users qualify. The two exam attempts are an allowance, not a guaranteed pass or unlimited examinations. Renew only while you remain eligible.

items.title: AWS Educate free cloud learning
items.summary: Free self-paced learning, selected hands-on cloud labs and digital badges without a credit card.
items.bestFor: Beginners aged 13 and over exploring cloud and AI skills
requirements: Create an AWS Educate account with an email address. Learners must be at least 13; the jobs board is for people aged 18 and over.
items.watchOut: AWS Educate badges are separate from paid AWS professional certification examinations. Internet and device costs remain.

items.title: Cisco Networking Academy free courses
items.summary: A selection of free self-paced technology courses through Cisco Networking Academy.
items.bestFor: Beginners interested in cybersecurity, networks, Python or AI
requirements: Choose a course marked free and self-paced, then create a Networking Academy learner account.
items.watchOut: Instructor-led courses and professional certification exams have separate conditions and may cost money. A course badge or completion record is not a Cisco professional certification.

items.title: South African Library for the Blind
items.provider: South African Library for the Blind
items.summary: Free accessible-library membership with audio and Braille reading resources for eligible members.
items.bestFor: People who are blind, have low vision or another qualifying print disability
requirements: Apply to SALB and have the eligibility section completed or certified by a competent authority. Ask the library which accessible formats and services suit your needs.
items.watchOut: Membership is for people with qualifying print disabilities. Device, connectivity and equipment arrangements depend on the service; check them with SALB.

items.title: City of Cape Town free library membership
items.provider: City of Cape Town free library membership
items.summary: Free public-library membership, borrowing and access to facilities including SmartCape computers and internet where available.
items.bestFor: Cape Town residents needing books, study space or computer access
requirements: Visit a City library with your identity document and proof of address. An adult must assist with a child’s registration.
items.watchOut: Borrowing rules, opening hours and computer availability vary by branch. Return items on time and check charges for lost or overdue materials.

items.title: ESSA free public employment services
items.summary: Free individual registration, job-search and matching support, with a CV compiled from your profile.
items.bestFor: Jobseekers registering their skills with public employment services
requirements: Register as an individual on the Department of Employment and Labour’s ESSA portal and supply the requested identity or work-authorisation details.
items.watchOut: Registration does not guarantee an interview, placement or job. Keep your profile accurate and check the requirements of each vacancy.

items.title: Khetha free career guidance
items.summary: Free public career information, advice and guidance, including online self-help resources.
items.bestFor: South Africans choosing subjects, further study or a career direction
requirements: Use CareerHelp or the National Career Advice Portal, or contact the official career-advice team. Have your question and relevant study or work background ready.
items.watchOut: Advice is free; phone, SMS, internet and travel costs can apply. Guidance does not guarantee admission, funding or employment.

items.title: HubSpot Academy free certifications
items.summary: Free online courses and selected certifications, including broadly useful marketing and sales subjects.
items.bestFor: People learning marketing, sales and customer-service skills
requirements: Create a free Academy account and complete the lessons, assessment and any practical exercises for your chosen certification.
items.watchOut: Some software-specific certifications require access to paid HubSpot features for practical work. Check the full course requirements before starting.

items.title: Forage free job simulations
items.summary: Free self-paced employer-designed job simulations, with completion certificates for finished programmes.
items.bestFor: Students and jobseekers exploring what different roles involve
requirements: Create an account, choose a simulation and complete its tasks. Use the programme’s own instructions to compare your work with example answers.
items.watchOut: A simulation is educational practice, not employment, an internship placement or a professional qualification.

items.title: FAO elearning Academy
items.summary: Free multilingual self-paced courses; selected certified courses offer digital badges after assessment.
items.bestFor: Learners working in agriculture, food systems, nutrition or sustainability
requirements: Create a free account for tracked learning and assessment. Choose a course and check its language, download options and certification label.
items.watchOut: Not every course offers a badge. Certified-course assessments normally require at least 75%; a badge is not a professional licence.

items.title: DisasterReady Core Humanitarian Certification
items.summary: Free preparation material and the Core Humanitarian Certification assessment.
items.bestFor: People entering humanitarian work or refreshing core knowledge
requirements: Create a DisasterReady account with an email address, verify it and follow the certification instructions.
items.watchOut: The credential is not a job offer, professional licence or guarantee of deployment. Data and device costs remain.

items.title: NWU AI for Academic and Career Success
items.provider: NWU AI for Academic and Career Success
items.summary: A free two-hour self-paced AI course, with an NWU AI certificate and a personal career plan after successful completion.
items.bestFor: NWU students with access to the university’s eFundi learning system
requirements: Use the graduate-student course link on NWU’s AI training page and sign in through the university learning system.
items.watchOut: This guide is for eligible NWU institutional users. It does not promise public enrolment for people outside NWU or the separate lecturer incentive.

items.title: Digify PRO Foundations
items.summary: Free introductory digital-skills learning through the Digify PRO Foundations route.
items.bestFor: South Africans aged 18–35 building introductory digital-marketing skills
requirements: Be aged 18–35 in South Africa, complete the official interest/application form and follow the programme’s access instructions.
items.watchOut: Foundations applications are described as year-round. Progression to later phases requires completing the preceding phase and meeting selection requirements.

items.title: Second Chance Matric revision resources
items.summary: Official study guides, revision material and other learning support for matric preparation.
items.bestFor: Learners preparing to improve or complete eligible matric subjects
requirements: Use the DBE’s Second Chance resources and confirm your separate examination eligibility and registration with the education authorities.
items.watchOut: Access to revision material does not register you for an exam. The August–October 2026 teaching period has ended; check current dates before seeking a class.

items.title: YES × Microsoft AI learning and conditional exam vouchers
items.provider: YES × Microsoft AI learning and conditional exam vouchers
items.summary: Free AI learning with a conditional route to one funded certification examination voucher, subject to the programme’s requirements and allocation.
items.bestFor: South Africans completing eligible Microsoft AI learning paths
requirements: Use the official programme, have a South African ID and Microsoft Learn profile, complete the specified modules, score at least 70% on the practice assessment and submit the required survey and evidence.
items.watchOut: A claim does not guarantee a voucher or immediate availability. The announced 50,000 allocation is not a live stock count. The separate Takealot prize draw ended on 31 October 2026.

items.title: Mopani Baby Club: information pack and qualifying baby bag
items.provider: Mopani Baby Club: information pack and qualifying baby bag
items.summary: Joining provides an information welcome pack. A separate baby bag becomes available after R1,250 qualifying spend on an active Baby Club/Mopani Card profile.
items.bestFor: Expecting parents able to use Mopani’s Mpumalanga stores
requirements: Complete the Baby Club form with the due date; a new application is needed for each pregnancy. Use the Mopani Card for qualifying purchases and wait for the collection SMS. The second bag is supplied in the third trimester.
items.watchOut: The product bag requires paid shopping and contents vary with stock. The blog says in-store collection, while current terms also mention dispatch with a qualifying online purchase; confirm dispatch directly before relying on delivery.

items.title: Melomed Melobabes pregnancy programme
items.summary: The programme advertises complimentary antenatal classes, pregnancy information and a downloadable journal. On maternity admission, members receive a nappy bag with nappies and selected toiletries.
items.bestFor: Expecting parents planning maternity care at a participating Melomed hospital
requirements: Register through the official Melobabes page and ask the chosen hospital’s Client Service Officer about class dates and local benefit availability.
items.watchOut: The bag is linked to hospital admission; private maternity care is paid. Benefits vary by hospital. Registration does not guarantee every listed service at every facility.

items.title: Coloplast SpeediCath Short free sample
items.summary: People who currently use, or have been prescribed, an intermittent catheter can request a free SpeediCath Short sample for Coloplast suitability review.
requirements: South African delivery address required
Contact details required
Product-suitability information required
Coloplast Care Advisor approval required
items.watchOut: Availability and provider approval can change.

items.title: Coloplast SenSura Mio free sample
items.summary: People with a relevant ostomy-product need can request a free SenSura Mio sample for Coloplast suitability review.
requirements: South African delivery address required
Contact details required
Product-suitability information required
Coloplast Care Advisor approval required
items.watchOut: Availability and provider approval can change.

items.title: Coloplast Brava Elastic Tape free sample
items.summary: People with a relevant ostomy-product need can request a free Brava Elastic Tape sample for Coloplast suitability review.
requirements: South African delivery address required
Contact details required
Product-suitability information required
Coloplast Care Advisor approval required
items.watchOut: Availability and provider approval can change.

items.summary: People with a relevant ostomy-product need can request a free SenSura Mio Click sample for Coloplast suitability review.
requirements: South African delivery address required
Contact details required
Product-suitability information required
Coloplast Care Advisor approval required
items.watchOut: Availability and provider approval can change.

items.title: Blind Designs free fabric samples
items.summary: People in South Africa can order up to five Blind Designs blind or curtain fabric sample pieces per delivery with free delivery to a South African address.
requirements: South African delivery address required
Contact and delivery details required
Select a blind or curtain range and up to five fabric pieces per delivery
items.watchOut: Availability and provider approval can change.

items.title: Table Mountain Cableway free birthday ticket
items.summary: South African citizens can collect a free Cableway birthday ticket during their calendar birthday month by showing accepted South African identification in person at the ticket office or Visitor Information Centre.
requirements: Valid South African ID, driver's licence or birth certificate required
Collect in person during the calendar month of your birthday
items.watchOut: Availability and provider approval can change.

items.title: Two Oceans Aquarium free birthday-month entry
items.summary: South African citizens and permanent residents aged four or older can claim one complimentary Aquarium visit during their birthday month at the onsite ticket office.
requirements: Accepted identification showing a South African ID number and birth date required
Collect and use the ticket in person on the same day during your birthday month
Children aged 13 or younger must be accompanied by an adult ticket-holder
items.watchOut: Availability and provider approval can change.

items.title: Cape Wheel Birthday Club Free Ride
items.summary: Cape Wheel Birthday Club members over 12 receive a free standard ride after signing up before their birthday. VIP and Sky Dining are excluded; any photo-pack purchase is separate.
requirements: Free Birthday Club registration before the birthday required
Identification showing date of birth required
Printed emailed voucher required for redemption after the actual birthday
Birthday Club is for people over 12; younger children have a separate Kids Club
items.watchOut: Availability and provider approval can change.

items.title: Zeitz MOCAA free birthday and Wednesday access
items.summary: Visitors with accepted South African or African identification can visit free during their birthday month; African citizens also receive free entry every Wednesday from 10:00 to 13:00, and under-18s enter free year-round.
requirements: Valid South African ID or African passport reflecting the birth date required
Birthday access is available Monday to Sunday during normal opening hours; free Wednesday entry requires arrival from 10:00 to 13:00.
items.watchOut: Availability and provider approval can change.

items.title: Robben Island Museum free birthday tour
items.summary: Visitors with a South African ID can collect a complimentary standard Robben Island tour ticket at the Nelson Mandela Gateway ticket sales office on their actual birthday, subject to tour capacity and operations.
requirements: South African ID showing the birth date required
Collect at the Nelson Mandela Gateway ticket sales office on the actual birthday; subject to tour availability
If tours are cancelled on the birthdate, the official FAQ permits an alternative visit date
items.watchOut: Availability and provider approval can change.

items.title: City Sightseeing free kids' birthday bus tickets
items.summary: Young Explorers Club members aged four to 17 receive a free one-day Classic bus ticket for themselves and one friend, valid from one week before to three weeks after the birthday.
requirements: Free Young Explorers Club registration at least two weeks before the birthday required
Birthday member and friend must each be aged four to 17
One child may be registered per email address with parent or guardian knowledge
items.watchOut: Availability and provider approval can change.

items.title: UpCycles free birthday bike ride
items.summary: UpCycles offers a complimentary one-hour bicycle ride on the visitor's actual birthday, with proof of birth date required at an operating Up Station.
requirements: Proof of birth date required
Redeem at an operating Up Station on the actual birthday
Minors must be accompanied by a legal guardian
items.watchOut: Availability and provider approval can change.

items.title: V&A Waterfront free birthday pedal-boat ride
items.provider: V&A Waterfront / Pedal Boat Cape Town
items.summary: The V&A Waterfront's current birthday guide lists a complimentary pedal-boat ride before noon on the birthday or during the birthday week, with identification showing the birth date required.
requirements: Valid identification showing the birth date required
Ride must start before noon during the stated birthday week
items.watchOut: Availability and provider approval can change.

items.title: Ster-Kinekor SK Club free birthday movie ticket
items.summary: SK Club members receive one free 2D or 3D birthday ticket valid for 30 days from their birth date after completing at least one SK Club transaction since joining.
requirements: Free SK Club membership required
At least one SK Club transaction since joining required
Ticket is limited to eligible 2D or 3D films and seat availability
items.watchOut: Availability and provider approval can change.

items.title: Mugg & Bean free birthday cake slice
items.summary: Qualifying Mugg & Bean Loyalty App members receive a birthday voucher for a cake slice at a Sit-Down restaurant or a bundt cake at On-The-Move. From 1 September 2026 it is issued on the actual birthday and is valid for 30 days. Two qualifying app uses in the preceding 12 months are required.
requirements: Mugg & Bean loyalty membership required
Mugg & Bean Loyalty App registration required
Use the app payment or receipt-scan feature at least twice in the preceding 12 months
Voucher must be used within its 30-day validity period
items.watchOut: Availability and provider approval can change.

items.title: Ocean Basket app birthday treat
items.summary: Ocean Basket app members may receive one complimentary birthday treat per year, redeemable for 30 days from their recorded birthday. The item varies by restaurant and availability; check your Rewards Wallet before visiting.
requirements: Ocean Basket app membership required
App membership is for people aged 18 or older
Register in the Ocean Basket app with a valid mobile number and email
Record your correct birthday; corrections require support
Confirm the item and conditions shown in your Rewards Wallet with the participating restaurant
items.watchOut: Availability and provider approval can change.

items.title: Starbucks Gold birthday drink
items.summary: Starbucks South Africa Gold members receive a birthday Free Drink Reward valid for 30 days. Gold requires 750 Stars earned within 12 months, so this is a benefit for qualifying loyalty customers, not a drink for every new signup.
requirements: Gold-level Starbucks Rewards membership required
Earn 750 Stars in 12 months through qualifying activity; another 750 Stars maintains Gold for the next year
Provide your birthday in your member profile and check the reward in your account
Redeem only at participating South African Starbucks stores
items.watchOut: Availability and provider approval can change.

items.title: Norval Foundation: Free Birthday-Month Admission
items.summary: Norval Foundation lists free entry during your birthday month and free admission for children under 18. Check closures before travelling.
requirements: Birthday-month benefit: the provider page confirms the timing but does not spell out nationality or every document type. Cape Town Tourism directs visitors to show valid ID at the front desk. Under-18 entry is separately free.
Check the official opening and closure information before visiting.
For the birthday benefit, bring valid ID and ask the front desk for birthday-month admission. Cape Town Tourism says no online birthday booking is needed.
For a child’s visit, confirm age-document and accompanying-adult arrangements with the venue.
Gallery 8 is closed on 14 November 2026; check for further temporary gallery closures before visiting.
Normal hours: Wednesday–Saturday 10:00–17:00; Sunday/public holidays 10:00–16:00; closed Monday/Tuesday. Last entry is 30 minutes before closing.
Do not assume birthday admission includes separately ticketed events, special activities or parking.
Qualifying admission is free. Parking is free for the first 30 minutes and R20 thereafter; transport and optional purchases are separate.

items.title: The Galileo: Free Birthday-Month Movie Entry
items.summary: South Africans with valid ID can pre-book a limited free birthday ticket for a qualifying Galileo screening during their birthday month.
requirements: South Africans with valid identification, attending during their birthday month and the operating season. Screening age ratings and the limited birthday-ticket allocation still apply.
Choose a qualifying show during your birthday month from the official movie line-up.
Pre-book the Free Birthday Ticket online through the Webtickets link on the provider page. Enter the required South African ID number.
Bring the same identification to the ticket station for birthday verification. The separate birthday-name animation form is not a ticket booking.
Excluded themed dates: 30/31 October, 24/25 December, 14 February, 26/28 March; Royale shows are also excluded.
Only standard movie admission is included. Outside chairs and backrests are not permitted.
Tickets can sell out; no available ticket or booking success has been assumed.
Qualifying standard admission is free. Blankets and backrests cost extra to rent; bring your own warm blanket if preferred.
One free standard birthday ticket per person per season; attend during your birthday month.
items.watchOut: Availability and provider approval can change.

items.title: Freedom Adventure Park: a free hour on your birthday
items.summary: Book a one-hour birthday pass at Freedom’s Canal Walk or Somerset West park for the actual birthday. Grip socks are required; any brand is accepted.
requirements: Reserve the birthday pass online for the actual birthday
Wear grip socks; any brand is accepted and buying socks costs extra if you do not own a pair
Complete the park waiver; minors need guardian consent and age-specific activity restrictions apply
items.watchOut: Availability and provider approval can change.

items.title: R100 off your first Mr Price app purchase of R500 or more
items.summary: Apply MRP100 to an eligible first app order of at least R500.
requirements: The first-purchase discount is for the South African Mr Price app. A qualifying paid order is required and delivery or collection charges can affect the final total. Stock, payment and app conditions apply. The current official welcome page does not state a fixed closing date.
items.watchOut: Confirm the current price, availability and terms with the provider before buying.

items.title: R400 off a first qualifying Superbalist order of R1,000
items.summary: New customers can apply FIRSTBUY to an eligible first order of at least R1,000. Delivery may cost extra.
requirements: First-time customers only, once per customer and one promotion per checkout. Sale and non-shippable products are excluded. A qualifying R1,000 basket becomes R600 before delivery. Check the actual delivery charge after discounts; this listing does not promise free delivery. No fixed campaign closing date is stated.
items.watchOut: Confirm the current price, availability and terms with the provider before buying.

items.title: Clicks Seniors Club: double points on qualifying Wednesdays
items.summary: Eligible Seniors Club members can earn double base ClubCard points on qualifying Wednesday shopping.
requirements: Age 60+ with date of birth or ID recorded for Seniors Club enrolment. Free ClubCard membership and qualifying purchases are required. Scan the card before payment; exclusions apply to regulated goods and amounts paid with cashback. Points convert to redeemable ClubCard rewards under the programme’s thresholds and expiry rules, rather than cash. The official pages use inconsistent percentage wording, so no flat cashback percentage is promised here.
items.watchOut: Confirm the current price, availability and terms with the provider before buying.

items.title: Kirstenbosch: free Tuesdays for South African senior residents
items.summary: South African residents over 60 can enter the garden free on Tuesdays that are not public holidays.
requirements: Present valid identification and proof of South African residency at the garden entrance. The current schedule lists normal South African adult entry at R110. Separately ticketed events, parking or transport and other garden services are not included. This concession applies to Kirstenbosch and should not be assumed at other SANBI gardens.
items.watchOut: Confirm the current price, availability and terms with the provider before buying.

items.title: Vodacom Summer: Up to Three Free Scratch & Win Plays Daily
items.summary: Eligible Vodacom customers opted into VodaBucks can use up to three free Scratch & Win plays each day across VodaPay and USSD, with at most one free USSD play. Rewards vary and are not guaranteed.
requirements: Eligible Vodacom Prepaid, Hybrid/Top-Up and Postpaid customers need a lawfully registered SIM and VodaBucks opt-in. Use the VodaPay app or dial *133# or *135#. The combined free limit is three plays per day, including at most one on USSD; a USSD play reduces the remaining VodaPay allocation. Free plays expire at 23:59 that day. Specific rewards, availability and expiry are shown in the app/journey or SMS; there is no guaranteed reward or value. Optional extra plays cost one VodaBucks each, up to five daily; paid Upsize offers are separate and you keep your original reward if you decline. Where VodaBucks must be claimed on VodaPay, claim then bank them before midnight on Friday of that same week. Normal participation/connectivity costs may apply; free describes the play allocation. Rewards are redeemed in South Africa, and reward bundles can incur normal usage charges after depletion or expiry. Opt-in includes programme administration and usage/behavioural processing; marketing SMS opt-out is separate. Read the detailed conditions and current official terms before taking part.
items.watchOut: Confirm the current price, availability and terms with the provider before buying.

items.title: Panarottis Rewards: signup flatbread and hot-drink rewards
items.summary: New members can redeem a flatbread voucher with R150 spend; buy ten qualifying hot drinks to earn the eleventh.
requirements: Signup flatbread vouchers require R150 minimum spend and last three months. Hot-drink reward vouchers follow ten qualifying purchases and also last three months; drink redemption applies to dine-in or call-and-collect, not Click & Collect. Flatbread redemption also permits Click & Collect. Adult membership and the app or supported loyalty channel are required; vouchers are personal and non-transferable. Staff exclusions apply.
items.watchOut: Confirm the current price, availability and terms with the provider before buying.

items.title: Free Streetopia Festival in Observatory
items.summary: Streetopia brings art, music and performances to the streets of Observatory, Cape Town, on 28 November with free admission.
requirements: The organiser confirms Saturday, 28 November 2026 and free admission. Use the organiser's current event information to plan the visit. The downloadable 2025 guide describes the previous edition.
items.watchOut: Confirm the current price, availability and terms with the provider before buying.

items.title: Free Main Street Sundays in Johannesburg
items.summary: Visit the car-free Main Street Sundays event in Marshalltown on 29 November. The organiser offers a free RSVP.
requirements: Jozi My Jozi lists free admission on Sunday, 29 November 2026 from 10:00 to 18:30 on Main Street, Marshalltown. Find the free RSVP link and current programme on the organiser's page. Transport, food and purchases are separate.
items.watchOut: Confirm the current price, availability and terms with the provider before buying.

items.title: Free Cape Town Festive Lights Switch-On
items.summary: Watch the free live music and lights switch-on at the Grand Parade on 29 November.
requirements: The City of Cape Town advertises free admission and entertainment from 16:00 to 22:00 on Sunday, 29 November 2026 at the Grand Parade. Check the City announcement for any updates, travel arrangements and road closures.
items.watchOut: Confirm the current price, availability and terms with the provider before buying.

items.title: Umatie: 20% Off Your First Online Order
items.summary: Use the retailer's public welcome code for 20% off your first online Umatie order.
requirements: First online order only. Enter the code before paying. Umatie does not combine codes. Its delivery page lists an R400 minimum order and location-specific delivery fees and coverage. The retailer does not state a code expiry.
items.watchOut: Confirm the current price, availability and terms with the provider before buying.

items.title: MIC SA Black November: 10% to 30% Off by Spend
items.summary: Save 10% from R1,000, 20% from R2,500 or 30% from R5,000 under MIC SA's Black November terms.
requirements: Shipping is excluded from qualifying spend. The highest qualifying tier applies and cannot be combined with other discounts. Check the order total before paying.
items.watchOut: Confirm the current price, availability and terms with the provider before buying.

items.title: Edgars via Payflex: R250 Off R1,000 on Eligible Fashion
items.summary: Use code 447382 for R250 off a qualifying R1,000 online fashion order. Payflex advertises the offer through 30 November 2026.
requirements: Enter the code at Edgars checkout on at least R1,000 of qualifying fashion and use Payflex for the advertised offer. FreeHub confirmed the R250 reduction at guest checkout on two regular-price fashion baskets. Check that the discount appears in your order summary before paying. Eligibility for sale items, other categories and combining discounts remains unconfirmed.
items.watchOut: Confirm the current price, availability and terms with the provider before buying.

items.title: Absa Fuel Relief: extra cashback on qualifying fuel spend until 15 November
items.summary: Eligible Absa Rewards members can earn an extra 10% on their first R1,500 of qualifying fuel spend, capped at R150 extra.
requirements: Runs 16 October–15 November 2026. Requires age 18+, qualifying South African citizenship or temporary residence, active Absa Rewards, transactional and credit accounts in good standing, and an Absa Advantage challenge completed in the preceding six months. Buy fuel exclusively at Sasol or Shell in the campaign month, using an eligible digital wallet or virtual Absa card. Shell V+ requirements apply. Fuel purchases and account fees remain payable; this is conditional cashback, not free fuel. Read the full terms before changing your usual fuel purchases.
items.watchOut: Confirm the current price, availability and terms with the provider before buying.

items.title: ATKV Goudini Spa: 30% off selected November weekend accommodation
items.summary: Book at least two nights in an eligible unit for the remaining 20–21 November 2026 weekend, subject to availability.
requirements: Book by 20 November 2026. Applies to Slanghoek A-Type and B-Type Villas, luxury five-sleeper rondavels and Badsberg flats. ATKV members and non-members qualify. Minimum two nights; telephone and online bookings accepted. Accommodation is paid. The earlier advertised weekends have passed or already started; this listing highlights 20–21 November only. No unit availability has been reserved.
items.watchOut: Confirm the current price, availability and terms with the provider before buying.

items.title: SANParks senior camping concession: 40% on qualifying November nights
items.summary: Qualifying pensioners can receive 40% off camping during the current 16 October–26 November window; eligible accommodation has park-specific rates.
requirements: For qualifying South African social pensioners and South African permanent residents aged 60+. Book in the qualifying guest’s name through SANParks reservations: online-platform bookings do not receive this concession. Fridays, Saturdays and long weekends are excluded. Bring ID or pension proof. Camping relief covers one site’s base tariff and qualifying persons; additional guests may pay full tariffs. Conservation fees and meals remain payable. Accommodation discounts depend on the exact camp and unit in the 2026 matrix.
items.watchOut: Confirm the current price, availability and terms with the provider before buying.

items.title: Telkom Summer: bonus Telkom-to-Telkom minutes with qualifying bundles
items.summary: New and existing prepaid or hybrid customers receive 200–2,000 Telkom-to-Telkom minutes with qualifying data or combo bundle purchases.
requirements: 4 October 2026–31 January 2027. Buy a qualifying data or data-and-voice bundle costing at least R29. Spend R29–R48 for 200 minutes valid three days; R49–R98 for 500 valid seven days; R99–R198 for 800 valid 14 days; R199 or more for 2,000 valid 31 days. Calls are limited to Telkom Mobile and Telkom fixed-line numbers. Unused minutes expire and cannot be transferred or carried over. The qualifying bundle is paid.
items.watchOut: Confirm the current price, availability and terms with the provider before buying.

items.title: The Galileo: R99 Wednesday tickets for South Africans aged 60+
items.summary: The 2026/27 pensioner ticket includes movie admission, a backrest and a blanket: R99 on Wednesdays or R155 for other eligible shows.
requirements: Season: 15 October 2026–15 May 2027. South Africans aged 60+ must enter and present valid ID. The regular pensioner Warm & Comfy ticket saves R25 against the stated R180 rate. Excludes themed Halloween, Christmas, Valentine’s and Easter screenings and Royale shows. Tickets are subject to availability; travel and refreshments are separate.
items.watchOut: Confirm the current price, availability and terms with the provider before buying.

items.title: Astron Energy Xtra Savings: earn Xcash on qualifying fuel
items.summary: Free Xtra Savings members earn 25c per litre, rising to 50c per litre across the qualifying month after more than R3,000 of fuel spend.
requirements: Adult active Xtra Savings members qualify at participating Astron forecourts. Scan or swipe your card at the forecourt terminal before paying; convenience-store tills and retrospective claims do not qualify. The monthly fuel cap is R4,000 or 190 litres, whichever comes first. The extra 25c is credited on the first of the next month after the spend threshold is met. Paid Xtra Savings Plus members earn 50c from the first qualifying litre. Xcash lasts 12 months and is usable at eligible group stores or Sixty60, not for fuel or cash; fleet purchases and specified services are excluded.
items.watchOut: Confirm the current price, availability and terms with the provider before buying.

items.title: John Dory’s app: ice cream and Bar-One sauce with R150 spend
items.summary: The app signup offer adds an Ice Cream & Bar-One Sauce dessert when you spend R150 or more.
requirements: Offer ends 14 January 2027. Requires the John Dory’s app and a qualifying R150 purchase. Use the issued offer in the app and check participating-restaurant availability before ordering. This is a purchase-linked dessert, not a no-spend sample.
items.watchOut: Confirm the current price, availability and terms with the provider before buying.

items.title: ATKV senior accommodation discounts for guests older than 55
items.summary: ATKV lists 15% off midweek and 10% off eligible weekend stays; Hartenbos offers 15% for both.
requirements: For members and non-members older than 55. Accommodation dates run 1 March 2026–28 February 2027, with bookings by 27 February. Applies to eligible self-catering units and camping, excluding school holidays and long weekends. General minimum stays are one night midweek and two at weekends; Hartenbos requires two nights. Group concessions require guests’ IDs. Paid accommodation and availability conditions apply.
items.watchOut: Confirm the current price, availability and terms with the provider before buying.

items.title: Apple Music: three months with an eligible new device
items.summary: Eligible new subscribers can claim three months of Apple Music, then the subscription renews at R69.99 a month unless cancelled.
requirements: Eligible Apple device purchase and setup are required. Redeem within 90 days of first setup or pairing, using the eligible device and Apple account. New individual subscribers only; one offer per account/device, with model restrictions and no combination with Apple One or other trials. Internet and device costs remain payable. Cancel at least one day before renewal; cancelling during the free period ends access immediately.
items.watchOut: Confirm the current price, availability and terms with the provider before buying.

items.title: Cotton On Perks: 20% off a qualifying first online order
items.summary: New South African Perks members receive an emailed welcome voucher for 20% off eligible full-price online shopping.
requirements: Free membership; a purchase is required. Use the unique voucher issued to your account before its stated expiry. Sale products, personalisation, Foundation products and gift cards are excluded. The South African voucher is for the South African site; delivery remains subject to the checkout total and conditions. This is separate from the Perks spend-and-earn voucher programme.
items.watchOut: Confirm the current price, availability and terms with the provider before buying.

items.title: Happy Folks loyalty: 5% in points and a qualifying birthday voucher
items.summary: Earn points worth 5% of qualifying transactions toward future bills; R1,000 annual spend qualifies for a R150 birthday-month discount.
requirements: Free app membership requires a South African mobile number and app-store region. Restaurant purchases are required. Present the app; one app per bill. Points are for future bills, not cash, tips or gift vouchers, and expire after three years. Direct-store takeaways qualify; third-party delivery does not. The birthday voucher has its own eligibility and displayed validity.
items.watchOut: Confirm the current price, availability and terms with the provider before buying.

items.title: Kapstadt Brauhaus: 5% in points and a qualifying R150 birthday voucher
items.summary: Earn restaurant credit from qualifying bills, with a R150 birthday-month discount after R1,000 annual spend.
requirements: Free app membership requires a South African mobile number and app-store region. Paid restaurant purchases are required. Scan the bill’s QR code within 12 hours; only one code can be scanned per day. One app per bill. Points cannot buy tips or gift vouchers and are not cash; unused points expire after three years. Direct-store takeaways qualify, third-party delivery does not.
items.watchOut: Confirm the current price, availability and terms with the provider before buying.

items.title: John Dory’s: selected sushi at half price on Wednesdays
items.summary: Order dishes from the designated Wednesday menu for 50% off their usual prices.
requirements: Available all day on Wednesdays at participating South African John Dory’s restaurants, subject to the designated half-price menu. Only listed sushi dishes qualify; this is not 50% off every item on the standard menu. Dining purchases are required. Check the selected restaurant and current menu before ordering.
items.watchOut: Confirm the current price, availability and terms with the provider before buying.

items.title: Krispy Kreme birthday offer: buy a dozen, get an Original Glazed dozen
items.summary: Eligible KKSA app users can redeem their birthday voucher for a free Original Glazed dozen when buying any dozen doughnuts.
requirements: Register in the South African KKSA app at least 48 hours before your birthday. The voucher arrives on the birthday and is valid for one year. Show the voucher and identification at a full Krispy Kreme shop. Excludes delivery and Doughnuts on the Go outlets, including those at Engen, Checkers and SPAR. A paid dozen is required; prices vary by your chosen dozen.
items.watchOut: Confirm the current price, availability and terms with the provider before buying.

items.title: LG South Africa: 5% welcome coupon for new members
items.summary: New LG online members can use a once-off 5% welcome coupon on eligible products and accessories.
requirements: Account registration is free; a qualifying purchase is required. The coupon is valid for 30 days after registration and only once. Eligible products and exclusions apply; delivery or service charges can affect the total. Check the coupon attached to your account before ordering.
items.watchOut: Confirm the current price, availability and terms with the provider before buying.

items.title: Spotify Premium Standard: one month free for eligible new subscribers
items.summary: Eligible first-time Premium users can try Standard for one month, then pay R69.99 a month unless they cancel.
requirements: For users who have not previously tried Premium. Requires a Spotify account and an eligible recurring payment method. Internet access costs are separate. The offer is the monthly Standard trial, not a prepaid wallet option or an expired multi-month promotion. Confirm the first billing date and cancel through your account before renewal to avoid the next charge.
items.watchOut: Confirm the current price, availability and terms with the provider before buying.

items.title: Builders: 10% off qualifying in-store Wednesday purchases for over-60s
items.summary: Eligible Builders cardholders older than 60 can receive a 10% Wednesday discount on qualifying in-store purchases.
requirements: Present your Builders card and age identification to the cashier in-store on Wednesday. Personal purchases only; no promotion stacking or later claim after forgetting the card. Excludes discounted or below-cost products, services, direct-to-site and special orders. Major exclusions include appliances, air conditioning, cables, building aggregates, copper fittings, generators, gas, window frames, geysers, tanks, doors, boards and ladders, plus Plascon, Dulux, Duram and HTH. The official terms use “over 60”; customers exactly 60 should confirm qualification. Online eligibility is contradictory: clause 20.9 excludes website-generated sales, while clause 36.2.1 mentions online checkout. This page confirms the in-store benefit only. Check with Builders before relying on a pensioner discount for any online purchase.
items.watchOut: Confirm the current price, availability and terms with the provider before buying.

items.title: Makro mSenior: savings on eligible food and general merchandise
items.summary: Registered shoppers aged 60+ can receive a product-dependent mSenior discount in-store and online.
requirements: Requires a valid mSenior Citizens Card/profile and South African ID or passport. Current October 2026 terms allow at most 5% on selected food and 10% on selected general merchandise, subject to Makro’s approved cost floor; these are not guaranteed flat reductions. Personal purchases only. Excludes promotions, Marketplace sellers, delivery, liquor, tobacco, cellular, gift/prepaid and financial products, LPG, motor oil, pool chemicals, copier paper and baby formula.
items.watchOut: Confirm the current price, availability and terms with the provider before buying.

items.title: Vodacom RED: eligible Amazon Prime trials of three or twelve months
items.summary: Qualifying RED Flexi customers can receive three months of Prime; RED Core customers can receive twelve. Thereafter, it costs R59 monthly unless cancelled.
requirements: A qualifying paid consumer contract is required. Be active on Vodacom for at least 30 days and have had no trial benefit in the previous 12 months. Business/corporate contracts do not qualify. Activate the offer shown through Vodacom’s website, VodaPay or an official invitation and link your Amazon account. Contract and data charges remain payable. This is the Amazon Prime benefit, distinct from older Prime Video Mobile Edition offers.
items.watchOut: Confirm the current price, availability and terms with the provider before buying.

items.title: SPAR Rewards Black Friday essentials: 12–15 November
items.summary: Selected in-store Rewards deals include Twinsaver 18-roll toilet tissue at R94.99, two Sunlight 750ml refills for R40, and qualifying Omo packs at R109.99.
requirements: 12–15 November 2026, while stocks last at participating SPAR, SUPERSPAR and KWIKSPAR stores. SPAR Rewards identification is required; excludes SPAR Express and SPAR2U. Limit five deals per product per customer. Exact packs: Twinsaver 2-ply 18 rolls of 350 sheets; two Sunlight 750ml refills; Omo 4kg powder or 3L liquid. The provider advertises savings of R80, R20 and R70 respectively; FreeHub has not independently audited historical prices.
items.watchOut: Confirm the current price, availability and terms with the provider before buying.
